choice.basis: The chart is a stacked bar of the three stations on a shared 'Number of Visitors' scale, so the top of each stack is the combined daily traffic. The 4,500 tick is printed on the axis. The Tue and Wed stack tops are visibly above the 4,500 line (combined > 4,500), while the Thu (and Mon) stack tops are visibly below it (combined < 4,500). Per the crowding-alert policy, submit exactly the dates whose combined total exceeds 4,500, which are Tue and Wed.
choice.option_label: Submit Tue and Wed for transit crowding alert
